map_area.title: Star Map
map_area.about: The area where the galaxy's stars, lanes and fleets are drawn and clicked.

sidebar.title: Sidebar
sidebar.about: The right-hand strip holding the stardate and the empire's figures (treasury, command, food, freighters, research).

nav_turn.title: Next Turn Button
nav_turn.about: The button at the bottom right that ends the turn.

nav_colonies.title: Colonies Button
nav_colonies.about: Button that opens the Colonies screen.

nav_planets.title: Planets Button
nav_planets.about: Button that opens the Planets screen.

nav_fleets.title: Fleets Button
nav_fleets.about: Button that opens the Fleets screen.

nav_leaders.title: Leaders Button
nav_leaders.about: Button that opens the Leaders screen.

nav_races.title: Races Button
nav_races.about: Button that opens the Races screen.

nav_info.title: Info Button
nav_info.about: Button that opens the Info screen.

sb_stardate_text.title: Stardate
sb_stardate_text.about: The stardate line at the top of the sidebar.

sb_treasury_text.title: Treasury Figure
sb_treasury_text.about: The sidebar's treasury text; a click here opens the tax rate popup.

sb_treasury_icon.title: Treasury Icon
sb_treasury_icon.about: The icon beside the treasury figure; a click here opens the tax rate popup.

sb_command_text.title: Command Points Figure
sb_command_text.about: The sidebar's command points text; a click here opens the game's command points notice.

sb_command_icon.title: Command Points Icon
sb_command_icon.about: The icon beside the command points figure; a click here opens the game's command points notice.

sb_food_text.title: Food Figure
sb_food_text.about: The sidebar's food text; a click here does nothing, as in the original.

sb_food_icon.title: Food Icon
sb_food_icon.about: The icon beside the food figure; a click here does nothing, as in the original.

sb_freighters_text.title: Freighters Figure
sb_freighters_text.about: The sidebar's freighters text; a click here starts the game's scrap freighters dialog, or says none can be scrapped.

sb_freighters_icon.title: Freighters Icon
sb_freighters_icon.about: The icon beside the freighters figure; a click here starts the scrap freighters dialog, or says none can be scrapped.

sb_research_text.title: Research Figure
sb_research_text.about: The sidebar's research text; a click here opens the research change window.

sb_research_icon.title: Research Icon
sb_research_icon.about: The icon beside the research figure; a click here opens the research change window.

help_popup.title: Help Panel
help_popup.about: The panel showing right-click help text; shown only while help is visible.

system_box.title: System Window
system_box.about: The frame of the star system window; shown only while the game has a system window open.

system_title.title: System Window Title
system_title.about: The title plate with the system's name; shown only while the system window is open.

system_view.title: System View
system_view.about: The picture of the star and its orbits inside the system window; shown only while it is open.

system_text.title: System Info Text
system_text.about: The information text in the system window; shown only while it is open.

system_close.title: System Close Button
system_close.about: The close button of the system window; shown only while it is open.

fleet_box.title: Fleet Window
fleet_box.about: The frame of the fleet selection box; shown only while the game has a fleet box open.

fleet_title.title: Fleet Window Title
fleet_title.about: The title strip of the fleet box: the race's Fleet line, or the ship's name; shown only while the fleet box is open.

fleet_grid.title: Fleet Ship Grid
fleet_grid.about: The 3 x 3 grid of ship cells in the fleet box, one ship per cell; click selects, with a scroll bar beyond nine ships.

fleet_status.title: Fleet Status Line
fleet_status.about: The status line of the fleet box (move line, refusal or scanned ship); shown only while it is open.

fleet_close.title: Fleet Close Button
fleet_close.about: The close button of the fleet box; shown only while the fleet box is open.
